speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; these are serious symptoms. To determine the underlying cause, can you tell me your age and your smoking history?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the timeline and severity of your symptoms. Given the "drenching" nature of your night sweats and the 12-pound weight loss, do you have any known history of malignancy or autoimmune disease, and do you have a fever or chills?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The description of a "fixed" and painless supraclavicular lymph node is highly concerning for malignancy. Have you noticed any changes in your stool, such as blood, black tarry material, or a change in bowel habits? Also, do you have a cough, shortness of breath, or hoarseness?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, and ESR.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CT, Chest_CT.
